title: Ashcovered Letter

The '''Ashcovered Letter''' is provided as an objective for {{questlong|Horde|1|Ashcovered Letter (quest)|Ashcovered Letter|race=Goblin|class=warrior}}.

==Contains==
{{Book|content=
<name>, I've seen how you handle your weapon and I must say - you show potential.

With a bit of training, we should be able to rough you up into a workable shape! Who knows, maybe you'll become a bruiser in the end, or even one of those adventurous types running around all of Azeroth. Whatever it will be, with enough money I can give you a nice headstart for your future career.

Gizzie the Enforcer, Warrior Trainer.
}}
